title: Erlang The Movie II: The Sequel
summary: A humorous 10-minute parody sequel to Erlang: The Movie, in which Erlang's creators discuss the aging language and meet a surprise helper. It plays on the Outlaw Techno Psychobitch joke for OTP.
why: HN loves it as a funny, shorter sequel and even uses it to introduce Erlang in university classes.

quote.text: I use Erlang the Movie and its Sequel whenever I teach my classes at Oxford Uni.
